title: WebPros security advisory (AV26-961)
description: As of September 23, 2026, WebPros is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Plesk extension "Plesk RESTful API"
	Versions 2.4.2 to 2.4.6

Plesk extension "Site Import"
	Prior to or equal to 1.12.1

WP Toolkit for cPanel
	Prior to or equal to 6.11.2-10794

cPanel/WHM
	Prior to 11.134.0.57
Prior to 11.136.0.41
Prior to 11.138.0.8
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
